summary: Settings are grouped by what they change: Look, Navigation, Courses, Study, Course pages, Sharing, Mods, Privacy and data, and About. Each section shows its everyday controls and keeps the rest under More options; All settings adds the power-user sections, and search finds every setting. The side list marks the section in view as you scroll. A "?" beside a setting opens its longer description, by click, tap, keyboard or resting the mouse on it. The settings page wears your Look: its background, surfaces, fonts and text size. Course tabs have an Automatic place, now the default: in Glaze's navigation when it is a top bar holding them on a wide window, above the course otherwise. Installs on the old default move to it once. Every widget fits its tile's size, on the Dashboard, in the sidebar, floating, in the navigation and on phones. The pet habitat is a room that fills its tile, in your Look's colors, with the pet's name, level and XP on it. The Pet button shows today's bonding moments left; Wellbeing, Decorate and Progress are one switcher, and the habitat's settings are in its ⋯ menu. A docked widget's Move up and Move down are in its ⋯ menu, and To Do keeps Share sessions and Export behind ⋯. Share sessions: Create stays off until it can succeed, saying what is missing, and offers your current Look when there is nothing else to share. Moodle: Density, Line height and course color tone work, as on Canvas and Blackboard. Blackboard: side panels and drawers, like Activity Stream's notification settings, open below Glaze's top bar with Close in reach, and the pet and Return home step aside while a panel, a dialog or Settings is open. Nothing on the page draws over Settings opened inside a course page. A page opened while Glaze wasn't answering fills in by itself, without a reload. Widget buttons keep readable text in every Look, on hover and focus too. Blackboard: Card grades only on hover blurs GPA figures too, as on Canvas, and outlines without Blackboard's actions column no longer leave a second blank column beside the sidebar. Canvas: navigation trays keep their room while Glaze navigation is on. Links to old settings addresses open the right section, and a link to a section scrolls to it.
